items.title: Why did Apple buy AI music startup Samplab, and how might this impact Logic Pro?
items.excerpt: Apple acquired AI audio startup Samplab (disclosed via an EU Digital Markets Act filing), seemingly to bolster Logic Pro's AI tools such as polyphonic audio-to-MIDI and note editing.

items.title: Stop sending me vibecoded AI plugins, I'm begging you
items.excerpt: MusicTech's inbox is drowning in vibecoded plugins; the piece explains why that is a problem for producers and which indie developers are using AI coding responsibly.

items.title: Who's Buying All These Vibe-Coded Plugins?
items.excerpt: A long read on whether vibe-coded plugins are actually taking over the market, with two developers explaining how they use AI in their build process.

items.title: Just 4 Noise launches ethically-trained AI kick-drum generator
items.excerpt: Just 4 Kicks generates kick-drum samples from a model trained on licensed material, part of a wider trend of ethically-trained, producer-facing AI music tools.

items.title: Suno-made track 'The Adult I Dreamed Of' is a hit in South Korea
items.excerpt: After 'Forest of the Heart' charted on Melon last month, another Suno-generated song, 'The Adult I Dreamed Of', has become a hit in South Korea, reigniting the AI-music chart debate.

items.title: Duke Sanford study explores AI-music encounters on Spotify
items.excerpt: 'Spotify won't label AI music. We tried to detect it ourselves': Duke Sanford Tech Policy Program researchers measured how often listeners encounter AI-generated tracks on Spotify.

items.title: Deezer Announces 'On/Off Toggle' for AI Audio, Enabling Users to Remove Fully AI-Generated Music
items.excerpt: Deezer announced an AI audio on/off toggle that will let users remove fully AI-generated music from their experience, building on its AI detection and tagging system.

items.title: YouTube Music Adds Labels for Tracks 'Created Primarily' With Gen AI
items.excerpt: YouTube Music began labelling songs 'created primarily using generative AI' on 14 October, using its own detection system, saying listeners asked for transparency.

items.title: Sony Music, UMG File New Legal Action Against DistroKid to Force Disclosure of AI Uploads
items.excerpt: Universal Music Group and Sony Music filed a legal action to force DistroKid to disclose how many AI-generated songs (including Suno output) it delivers to DSPs.

items.title: Major labels are getting 'massive corporate payouts' for AI licensing but 'paying musicians zero', says AFM's 'Human Made Human Paid' campaign
items.excerpt: US performer union AFM launched a campaign demanding musician consent and pay before recordings are used in label AI licensing deals.

items.title: Using AI To Make Patches For The Yamaha CS-80 Synthesizer
items.excerpt: Jose's Vintage Keys uses Anthropic's Claude to control a MIDI-upgraded Yamaha CS-80 and design patches, showing AI as a sound-design assistant for vintage hardware.

items.title: Elektron Responds To Explosion Of Unofficial Firmware
items.excerpt: EZBOT shares takeaways from an hour-long call with Elektron about AI and its impact on the company, and the wave of AI-assisted hacked firmware for its devices.

items.title: POLL: What do you think about AI in music software?
items.excerpt: BPB says AI-assisted coding and text-to-music tools have flooded the plugin market and lowered quality; it is filtering AI-generated software from its news and polling readers on where to draw the line.

items.title: Romain Gavras Is Bummed About Those AI Versions of 'Storm'
items.excerpt: Director Romain Gavras says AI copycat 'recreations' of his Yung Lean 'Storm' video made him sad for the crew who put in so much work on the real thing.

items.title: What Should Music Awards Recognize in the Age of AI?
items.excerpt: Argues human creative decisions behind AI-assisted work remain central and that awards organizations need transparency rules about AI use.

items.title: Streaming Fraud Threatens More Than Fraudsters. We Must Find Meaningful Solutions (Guest Column)
items.excerpt: NMPA chief David Israelite argues streaming fraud, exacerbated by AI-generated tracks (Deezer: 90,000 a day), drains songwriter royalties and needs industry solutions.

items.title: IAMDDB accuses Israel of 'stealing her identity' in AI propaganda video
items.excerpt: Manchester artist IAMDDB says a now-deleted government clip used an AI-generated likeness of her, raising artist-likeness and deepfake concerns.

items.title: Apple's latest acquisition suggests Logic Pro is getting Melodyne-style polyphonic note editing
items.excerpt: AI audio company Samplab was acquired by Apple in June per EU disclosures, hinting at Melodyne-style polyphonic editing coming to Logic Pro. (Same story as MusicTech item.)
